literal: Greatness will indeed always bow; smallness will indeed adorn itself admiring itself.
translation: Greatness always behaves with humility; smallness, however, adorns itself with self-admiration.
modern: பெருமைக்குரிய பண்பு எப்போதும் பணிவோடு நடக்கும்; ஆனால் சிறுமையான பண்பு தன்னைத்தானே வியந்து பாராட்டிப் பெருமைப்படுத்திக் கொள்ளும்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the behavior of truly noble minds with that of small-minded people. Greatness (பெருமை) is characterized by constant humility (பணியுமாம் என்றும்); those who are truly great do not boast but remain humble. In contrast, smallness of character (சிறுமை) is marked by self-admiration (தன்னை வியந்து), where such individuals constantly praise themselves and metaphorically 'adorn' themselves with vanity (அணியுமாம்). The particle 'ஆம்' in both verbs emphasizes that these are natural, observable truths of human behavior.
